title: Inventory
subtitle: Stock levels and the movements that produced them.
reservedNote: Reserved stock is declared in the schema but nothing writes it until checkout lands.

levels.emptyDescription: Stock appears here once products are received.

movements.emptyDescription: Every stock change is written here and never overwritten.
movements.appendOnly: This ledger is append-only. A correction is a new movement, never an edit.

adjustDialog.title: Adjust stock
adjustDialog.description: Records a movement against {product}. Stock is never overwritten.
adjustDialog.quantityHint: Positive adds stock, negative removes it.
